interpretation: Reference-repeatability-motivated conditional box only. Not measured sample-specific errors, a95%confidence interval, a full error covariance, or a conservative true bound. Common element shifts represent coherent systematic directions that do not diminish with sample count. All16vectors and all9pHscenarios are retained; no best-scenario selection. These are16 sampled corners only; there is no proof of extrema or uniform robustness over the continuous error box, especially for nonlinear model-minus-baseline RMSE.
source_locator: GP15 Leg2 REE intercalibration PDF8 Table2 andPDF9 Table3; maximum among listed reference-water RSDs for each of the four elements
baseline_rule: No REE perturbation of depth baseline. Both model and baseline receive identical training-reference pH shifts and are compared with identical observed-target shifts and layer support.
